content: When PduR_DcmCancelTransmit() returns E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall assume that the ongoing transmission cannot be cancelled and shall not retry to cancel the transmit request. The current protocol shall be stopped and the new one started.

When PduR_DcmCancelTransmit() returns E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall assume that the ongoing transmission cannot be cancelled and shall not retry to cancel the transmit request. The current protocol shall be stopped and the new one started.
When PduR_DcmCancelTransmit() returns E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall stop the current protocol.
When PduR_DcmCancelTransmit() returns E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall stop the current protocol.
